en.title: Save Then Publish Is Not Atomic: The Dual-Write Problem and the Outbox
en.subtitle: No transaction covers your database and your broker, so a failure between the two writes loses events silently. Commit the event with the data and relay it.

ar-EG.title: الـ save وبعده publish مش atomic: مشكلة الـ dual write والـ outbox pattern
ar-EG.subtitle: مفيش transaction بتغطي الداتابيز والـ broker مع بعض، فأي فشل بين الكتابتين بيضيّع events من غير صوت. اعمل commit للـ event مع الداتا وخلّي relay ينشره.
